Land/sea use change.description: increasing global average temperatures and their local/regional modification; increasing atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases, in particular CO2, and their consequences such as, for instance, sea level rise, ocean acidification, changing temperature and precipitation patterns, destabilisation of weather patterns and changes in the frequency and strength of extreme weather events

threat_categories.name: Human Intrusions & Disturbance
threat_categories.note: Included when disturbance is fundamentally linked to land/sea-use pressure or spatial reconfiguration

threat_categories.name: Invasive & Other Problematic Species, Genes & Diseases
threat_categories.note: IPBES driver corresponds specifically to the invasive alien species subset

Excluded_or_Non_anthropogenic.name: Geological Events
Excluded_or_Non_anthropogenic.note: Not considered a direct anthropogenic driver under IPBES
